The rendered façade and long driveway create an impressive welcome, with ample room to accommodate multiple vehicles. Inside, high ceilings of approximately 2.7 metres, upgraded cornices and large windows give the interiors a sense of scale, light and refinement.

A versatile front lounge offers an elegant setting for welcoming guests or enjoying a quiet retreat. The large master bedroom continues the feeling of spaciousness, while the remaining bedrooms provide flexibility for family, visitors or a home office. Flooring installed in 2025 across the bedrooms and lounge/theatre spaces adds a fresh finish.

Lush greenery, privacy hedging and synthetic grass create an inviting garden with an emphasis on easy upkeep. Mature apple, cherry and lemon trees, a curry leaf tree and a vegetable patch add character and everyday enjoyment to the generous backyard.

The oversized garage offers roller-door access and backyard access, with valuable space for storage and practical family needs. Ducted heating and evaporative cooling complete a home designed for comfort throughout the seasons.

Further features include:


Flooring installed in 2025 across the bedrooms and lounge/theatre areas. No carpets

Updated ducted heating system and water heater.

Security camera system.

Long driveway with parking for multiple vehicles.

Generous private gardens with several outdoor entertaining zones.

Enjoy easy access to Featherbrook Shopping Centre, Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre, local schools, Milestones Early Learning, parks and public transport, all from a peaceful cul-de-sac setting.

A home of grand proportions, elegant detail and exceptional entertaining potential-ready to welcome its next family.

Positioned within the prestigious and securely gated Jardin Estate at Sanctuary Lakes, 20 Montclair Street presents an exceptional opportunity to embrace an exclusive lifestyle surrounded by resort-style amenities, tranquil green spaces and the renowned Sanctuary Lakes Golf Course.

Thoughtfully designed for comfortable family living, this impressive residence offers four spacious bedrooms and two well-appointed bathrooms, complemented by generous living spaces and an inviting outdoor area ideal for families to relax, entertain and enjoy quality time together. A large dining area provides the perfect setting for everything from everyday family meals to hosting guests on special occasions.

The home is filled with an abundance of natural light; multiple windows throughout allow plenty of sunshine to filter into the interiors, creating a bright, warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout the day.

Nestled within this tightly held residential community, residents enjoy the peace of mind of 24/7 security, along with exclusive access to a private residents-only park and an array of premium recreational facilities. With direct positioning alongside the Greg Norman-designed Sanctuary Lakes Golf Course, residents can enjoy picturesque lakeside walking trails, cycling paths, beautifully maintained open spaces and the natural surrounds of the nearby Cheetham Wetlands.

Jardin Estate residents also benefit from complimentary access to the community centre, featuring a fully equipped gym, swimming pool and golf course facilities, creating an enviable resort-style lifestyle right at your doorstep.

Beyond the estate, the location continues to impress with a selection of established schools and educational facilities nearby, including Carranballac P-9 College, Altona Green Primary School, Point Cook Senior Secondary College and Homestead Senior Secondary College. Local supermarkets, Pacific Werribee Shopping Centre and an abundance of cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities are also within easy reach.

For commuters, convenient freeway access provides a direct connection towards Melbourne CBD and surrounding suburbs, while the peaceful surrounds of Sanctuary Lakes offer a welcome retreat from the pace of everyday life.

Offering a rare combination of space, natural light, family functionality, security and resort-style living, 20 Montclair Street presents an outstanding opportunity to secure a home within one of Sanctuary Lakes' most tightly held communities.

out.ogDescription:
Every now and then, a home comes to market that simply can't be compared to anything else.
Not because it's bigger.
Not because it's newer.
But because it was designed to be different.

Welcome to 80 Urban Drive, Williams Landing, an architecturally designed family residence where soaring spaces, luxury finishes and thoughtful design come together to create a home unlike anything currently available.

Positioned on a substantial 701m² (approx.) allotment within the prestigious Wyndham Waters Estate, this remarkable residence isn't just somewhere to live, it's somewhere you'll be proud to come home to every single day.

From the moment you arrive, it's obvious this isn't another project-built home. The striking façade, manicured gardens and timber-decked entrance immediately set the tone for what's waiting inside.

Then you open the front door...
And everything changes.

A Living Space That Leaves a Lasting Impression
The centrepiece of this remarkable home is the breathtaking open-plan living and dining area.
Towering 5.5-metre ceilings create an incredible sense of scale, while expansive windows flood the home with natural light from every direction.
Standing in this space, surrounded by glass and volume, you instantly appreciate why homes like this are so rarely offered for sale.
It's dramatic.
It's elegant.
And it's designed for families who love entertaining.
The gourmet kitchen forms the heart of the home, featuring stone benchtops, quality Blanco 900mm cooking appliances, Bosch dishwasher, tiled splashback and an extended walk-in pantry that offers exceptional storage and functionality.
Whether you're hosting dinner parties or enjoying quiet family meals, this is a space where everyone naturally comes together.

A Private Parents' Retreat Like No Other
While the downstairs level has been designed for family living, the entire upper level has been reserved exclusively for the homeowners.
Your own private sanctuary.
A generous retreat overlooks the stunning void below, creating the perfect second living space to unwind at the end of the day.
Beyond that awaits an oversized master suite featuring:
• A huge walk-in robe
• Luxurious dual vanity ensuite
• Spa bath
• Underfloor heating
• Separate toilet
It's less like a bedroom...
And more like checking into your own boutique hotel every night.

Designed for Family Life
Flexibility is one of this home's greatest strengths.
Offering the versatility of up to five bedrooms, the floorplan easily adapts to growing families, those working from home, or buyers wanting dedicated theatre, study or guest accommodation.
Outside, beautifully landscaped gardens surround a large alfresco entertaining area, creating the perfect environment for weekend barbeques, family celebrations or simply enjoying a quiet afternoon outdoors.
Every inch of the property has been carefully planned to create a home that's as practical as it is beautiful.

Prestigious Wyndham Waters Estate
Living in Wyndham Waters is about much more than owning a beautiful home.
Residents enjoy exclusive access to the Wyndham Waters Leisure Centre, featuring:
• Indoor swimming pool
• Fully equipped gym
• Tennis court
• BBQ facilities
• Function room

All accessed securely via residents' swipe card.
You'll also enjoy exceptional convenience with easy access to:
• Williams Landing Shopping Centre
• Williams Landing Train Station
• Williams Landing Town Centre
• Truganina South Primary School
• Westbourne Grammar School
• Childcare centres
• Wetlands, walking trails and parklands
• Princes Freeway connecting Melbourne and Geelong

It's one of the west's most desirable family communities-and it's easy to see why.

Premium Features
• Architecturally designed family residence
• Huge 701m² (approx.) allotment
• Stunning 5.5-metre void over the main living area
• Heated concrete flooring for year-round comfort
• Up to five bedrooms or flexible living configuration
• Upstairs parents' retreat with private living area
• Oversized master suite with luxurious ensuite, spa and walk-in robe
• Gourmet kitchen with Blanco 900mm appliances
• Extended walk-in pantry
• Stone benchtops throughout
• Large alfresco entertaining area
• Beautifully landscaped gardens
• Zoned slab heating with polished concrete flooring
• Four refrigerated heating and cooling split systems
• Solar panels with gas-boosted solar hot water
• Security cameras and alarm system
• Gigabit ethernet cabling throughout
• Hardwood timber staircase
• Double remote garage
• Side access
• Garden sheds and greenhouse

A Home That Can't Be Replicated
There are beautiful homes...
There are luxury homes...
And then there are homes like 80 Urban Drive.
A residence where architecture, scale and individuality come together to create something genuinely unforgettable.
Your family and friends will admire it.
Your children will grow up remembering it.
And unless someone is prepared to buy land and build from scratch, they're unlikely to ever own anything quite like it.
This isn't just another house.
It's a statement.
